# Vendored third-party libraries

| Folder | Library | Version | License | Commercial use | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lucide/` | Lucide browser icons | 0.468.0 | ISC (Lucide), MIT (Feather-derived icons); see LICENSE | yes | Local UMD bundle used by the Chibi 2 comparison tools. |
| `three/` | Three.js (+ addons GLTFLoader, OrbitControls, SkeletonUtils, BufferGeometryUtils, GLTFExporter, and — added 2026-09-22 for `highdef-3d/` — the post-processing chain (EffectComposer, RenderPass, ShaderPass, OutputPass, UnrealBloomPass, SMAAPass, GTAOPass, SSAOPass, BokehPass + their shaders), `objects/Sky.js`, `objects/Water.js` and `csm/` for cascaded shadow maps) | r186 | MIT | yes | Import via importmap `"three": "/vendor/three/three.module.js"`, addons import `three` so the importmap is required. The extra addons were fetched from unpkg at the matching version by following each file's own relative imports, so nothing is missing a dependency. |
| `cannon-es/` | cannon-es — pure-JS rigid-body physics (ES module `cannon-es.js`, runs in the browser AND in Node; added 2026-10-23 for `prototypes/knockabout/`) | 0.20.0 | MIT | yes | Fetched with `npm pack cannon-es@0.20.0`, `dist/cannon-es.js` + LICENSE only. Import by relative path (no bare specifier). |
| `meshopt/` | meshoptimizer's `meshopt_decoder.mjs` — decodes EXT_meshopt_compression GLBs (made by `gltfpack -cc`) for GLTFLoader.setMeshoptDecoder; added 2026-10-16 for Chibi 4's kit (`avatar-3d/chibi4/`) | 1.3.0 (npm `meshoptimizer`) | MIT (`meshopt/LICENSE.md`) | yes | `import { MeshoptDecoder } from '<...>/vendor/meshopt/meshopt_decoder.mjs'`; the encoder `gltfpack` is a devDependency used only by `avatar-3d/chibi4/tools/blender/step9_kit.py` |
| `mespeak/` | meSpeak.js (espeak 1.47 compiled to asm.js) — bundled from npm `mespeak` with a small patch adding `addVariant(name, text)` + `listVariants()` | 2.0.2 / meSpeak 1.9.6 | **GPL-3.0** | only if the game is GPL-compatible, or replace engine before shipping | Global `meSpeak`. Config `mespeak_config.json`, voices in `voices/`. Synthesizes to WAV bytes (`rawdata`). |
| `espeak-ng/` | espeak-ng CLI compiled to WASM (npm `espeak-ng` 1.0.2) | 1.0.2 | **GPL-3.0** | same as above | 18 MB. Used only to turn text into IPA phonemes (`--ipa`). Lazy-loaded. |
| `vits-web/` | @diffusionstudio/vits-web (Piper VITS TTS via ONNX Runtime Web) | 1.0.3 | MIT (voices: mostly permissive, check each model card) | yes | Loads onnxruntime from cdnjs and voice models from Hugging Face at runtime; needs internet on first use, then caches in the browser. |
| `onnxruntime-web/` | ONNX Runtime Web ESM bundle (needed by vits-web; the `.wasm` backends are still fetched from cdnjs at runtime) | 1.18.0 | MIT | yes | Mapped via importmap `onnxruntime-web` in `voice-lab/index.html`. |
| `peerjs/` | PeerJS (WebRTC data channels + the public PeerServer broker for signalling) — `peerjs.min.js` from npm `peerjs` dist | 1.5.5 | MIT (LICENSE copied) | yes | Classic script, defines `window.peerjs.Peer` / `window.Peer`. Loaded lazily by `prototypes/bannerline/js/net/peerjs.js` only when a player hosts or joins an online room. Uses the public broker `0.peerjs.com` by default; Bannerline's documented upgrade path is a Cloudflare Durable Objects relay (`prototypes/bannerline/docs/online.md`). |
| `pluralize/` | pluralize | 8.x | MIT | yes | English plural/singular rules, used by lingo as a fallback when a lexicon entry has no explicit plural. |
| `qrcode-generator/` | QR Code Generator for JavaScript (Kazuhiko Arase) — `qrcode.js` from npm `qrcode-generator` | 1.4.4 | MIT | yes | Classic script (UMD): defines a global `qrcode(typeNumber, errorLevel)`; `addData`, `make`, `getModuleCount`, `isDark(r, c)`. Loaded lazily by `prototypes/tumblefair/js/client/qr.js` to draw the join code as SVG. No network use. |

The CMU Pronouncing Dictionary (BSD) lives in `voice-lab/data/cmudict/` with its license. Asset packs (models/textures/audio) are documented next to the assets, e.g. `avatar-3d/assets/quaternius/` (CC0) and `sfx/assets/kenney/` (three Kenney audio packs — RPG Audio, Impact Sounds, Interface Sounds — **CC0 1.0**, commercial use fine, credit optional; see `sfx/assets/kenney/README.md` for the download commands and the per-pack license files).
